scope: PUBLIC, MODEL-ONLY PAPER RECOMMENDATIONS. NOT ACTUAL OWNER TRADES OR PRIVATE PORTFOLIO.
historical_pre_start: NOT_BACKFILLED; do not assert all older recommendations included until original dated messages recovered

policy.include: Every explicit model BUY/ADD/REDUCE/SELL/EXIT suggestion made to the user, including proposals rejected/not filled; WATCH/HOLD/REVIEW REQUIRED logged separately as decisions if useful, not trade recommendations
policy.never_publish: owner identity, actual portfolio shares, account/broker, holdings, tax lots, cost basis, reserve dollars, personal net worth, private source contents or executed trades
policy.prospective: Record the action, timestamp, independently source-dated reference quote, limit/trigger and veto BEFORE subsequent outcome. Never revise original prediction; append correction/superseding event.
policy.state: IDEA -> RECOMMENDED -> TRIGGERED_PAPER or NO_FILL or CANCELED or EXPIRED; then outcome reviews.
policy.benchmark: Specify liquid asset-class appropriate total-return benchmark in original event; also compare cash/SGOV with after-tax differences described separately, not fabricated.
policy.measurement: 5, 20, 60 completed NYSE sessions from first attainable prospective paper entry, then 120/252 where mature; split/dividend/ROC aware actual total return when evidenced, source + as-of on every input, subtract stated costs/slippage. If sources incomplete, result NULL and reason.
policy.metrics: signal count including unfavorable/no-fill; triggered count; absolute and excess total return; win rate, median and mean excess return; maximum adverse excursion; realized/unrealized and horizon maturity; drawdown, stress, turn-over; compare to no-action and safer benchmark; group by score band/veto/sector/regime
policy.calibration: Revisit causal explanations and false positives/false negatives; no change to frozen v1.4 weights, vetoes, bands, tranche logic without owner approval; warn about survivorship/selection/small-sample
